title: Tester quickstart path
agent_persona: An impatient first-time tester following the public quickstart and expecting useful output quickly.
goal: Install the examples extra from the built wheel and run `python -m rustscenic.quickstart`, including its network fallback path if PBMC-3k is unavailable.

commands.name: Build and install examples extra
commands.run:
python -m pip install --upgrade maturin
maturin build --release --manifest-path crates/rustscenic-py/Cargo.toml
WHL=$(ls target/wheels/rustscenic-*.whl | head -1)
python -m pip install "$WHL[examples]"
